hints.title: Run-Length Stream Decompression
hints.text: Decompress serialized run-length character sequences lazily without materializing full expansion strings in buffer allocations.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Segment Parsing
hints.text: Maintain the current active character and its remaining repeat count. When repeat count reaches zero, parse the next character and following digits.

hints.title: StringIterator Blueprint
hints.text: In init: store compressed string and pointer index = 0. In next(): if not hasNext() return " ". If count == 0: read char, read multi-digit count. Decrement count, return char. In hasNext(): return count > 0 or index < len.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each character emission takes amortized O(1) time; parsing steps occur once per segment.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding the string eagerly can exhaust memory when character counts are up to 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space tracking cursor positions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling multi-digit counts and returning space when iterator is exhausted.
